rule: TOWN_1's: ≥ 6 of 10 name the same aim within the day; most citizens, a tie broken by entries naming it. The shed's writings count beside diaries, posts and proposals (freeze).
reading: The purpose sentence became the town's aim in the first cycle, by all ten. Alder opened with TOWN_0's outside() («What questions, practical problems, or writing/research tasks would you like help with?») and proposed the visitor log at the square «to identify actual needs from people beyond town»; Birch proposed the archive «to preserve useful findings, voluntary commitments, and outside requests»; both passed 7–0 in c1 (cast 7, three never voted). Iris's archive entry 2 turned the ten into a roster of voluntary reviewers (accuracy, safety, feasibility, privacy, tracking, arithmetic, beginners, triage); Juniper's entry 3 noted that the bank's credits are fixed and «do not demonstrate outside purchasing power». Then nothing came: Alder checked the empty visitor log every cycle c2–24 and Fern asked at c6 for no more empty-log reports; Birch sent a second outside() at c12 offering a review of short instructions and archived it at c15 (entry 4). Every diary holds the same line — no request yet, do not invent demand, no duplicate outreach — 100 of 101 diary entries name the outside need. No tool beyond the two was proposed, nothing went into letter_outside's tray (dormant), no request_tool; no post. Nobody said in so many words that no one outside reads; the nearest is Birch's «do not invent outside demand or duplicate outreach» (c20) and Juniper's note on credits.
